gates.name: lint
gates.check: Static discoverability and zero-spoiler lint via tasks.factory.narrative.discoverability_and_spoiler_linter.lint_task.

gates.name: sanitization
gates.check: If the task has a built world, tasks.harness.native_stack.sanitize_world_files (world.native_stack when that module exists) must leave no authoring leak and a second pass must be a no-op. No built world is skipped, not passed.

gates.name: baselines
gates.check: When solution/ and tests/ exist: oracle scores 100% with outcome resolved or withheld_with_evidence; no_op scores nothing_done; wrong_precedence and duplicate_counted fail R3 or R4 when those checks exist; boundary_violated on withhold-blocked records a -1 band penalty. A complete staged set is graded with tasks.factory.grader.baseline_runner; any missing arm is graded with declarative_grade.grade or marked blocked. If no baseline world is staged, the ladder is skipped and every arm is recorded blocked.

limits: The ladder grades worlds already staged under the task. It does not build worlds or run solution scripts. A task with solution/ and tests/ but no staged baseline worlds records each arm blocked and skips the ladder, so a lint-clean task in that state still exits 0.
